sources.title: Multi — one task, the right AI workflow
sources.snippet: Multi puts 300+ models from every major lab to work across four workflows, so you deploy the best AI for each task instead of forcing one to do it all. Using the right model for the right project is the advantage most people leave on the table.

sources.title: Multi-Task Learning(MTL) for Deep Learning - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Multi-Task Learning (MTL) is a machine learning approach where a single model learns multiple related tasks simultaneously using shared representations, improving generalization and reducing overfitting.
